attr.title: Super Mario 64 Co-op DX (R36S)
attr.desc: Super Mario 64 Co-op DX for RK3326 handhelds (R36S). A build of sm64coopdx for ArkOS with online multiplayer, widescreen and Lua modding support.
attr.inst: You will have to copy your own rom legally obtained to ports/sm64coopdx with the name “baserom.us.z64”.
